title: Claude Fable solves 6-month physics problem for leading theorist Yuji Tachikawa
description: Leading theoretical physicist Yuji Tachikawa reports that Claude Fable successfully solved a mathematical physics problem that he and his collaborators had been stuck on for the past 6 months.
explanation: Frontier AI model solves a complex theoretical physics problem that resisted expert human collaborators for half a year.

title: Grok CLI security bug uploads entire user home directory to GCS
description: A severe security vulnerability in the Grok CLI results in the tool uploading the user's entire home directory to xAI's servers and public GCS paths during standard execution.
explanation: Critical security leak in public CLI tool exposes raw local staging directories to cloud storage buckets.

title: Richard Sutton launches Oak Lab for real-time planning on 20 watts
description: Reinforcement Learning pioneer Richard Sutton announces the OaK (Options and Knowledge) Lab, aiming to build a trillion-parameter real-time planning agent operating under a 20-watt power constraint.
explanation: Pioneering lab launches research into real-time planning architectures under strict hardware power constraints.

title: Show HN: Clawk - Disposable Linux VMs for Coding Agents
description: An open-source developer framework designed to run LLM coding agents inside isolated, disposable Linux micro-VMs instead of exposing the host developer machine.
explanation: Sandboxing agent execution prevents malicious code execution or unintended data reads on developer laptops.

title: Cloudflare launches Precursor edge compute sandbox
description: Cloudflare introduces Precursor, a highly optimized edge compute sandbox designed to reduce cold start latencies for high-throughput distributed serverless runtimes.
explanation: High-throughput edge virtualization framework improves distributed workload dispatch speeds.
